headline: Market closed for weekend; Shriram Finance to join Sensex as Trent exits in upcoming rejig

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Wednesday, 25 November.

why: The market is closed today due to the weekend.
BSE announced a Sensex index rejig effective from December 21.
Lodha Developers announced a transition in its board leadership.
October engineering export data showed significant growth in US shipments.
whatHappening: Shriram Finance is scheduled to replace Trent in the BSE Sensex index starting December 21.
Mukund Chitale has stepped down as Chairman of Lodha Developers, with Akhil Gupta named as his successor.
India's engineering exports surged 36% in October, supported by robust demand from the United States.
The Labour Ministry has introduced a new job-matching portal and an occupational shortage index.
summary: The Indian market remains closed for the weekend, with attention on the upcoming Sensex rejig where Shriram Finance replaces Trent. Corporate news is highlighted by a leadership change at Lodha Developers. Economic indicators remain positive as engineering exports jumped 36% in October.
